title: Discord Emotes
description: Type Discord shortcodes like :skull: or :fire: in chat and watch them turn into inline emoji, just like Discord. Includes 78 Twemoji emotes rendered at text height. Fully client-side, so it works on any server (vanilla too) and others don't need it
body: Type Discord-style shortcodes like :skull:, :fire:, or :100: straight into chat and watch them turn into real inline emoji, exactly the way they look in Discord. It ships with 78 hand-picked emotes from the same Twemoji set Discord uses, each rendered crisp and sized to sit neatly inline with your text. Everything is fully client-side, so it only changes how chat looks on your own screen — it works on any server, vanilla ones included, and nobody else you're playing with needs to install a thing. There's nothing to set up or configure either: just drop it in and start spamming emotes.
